assets.purpose: Full-window empty table environment beneath actual game UI; usable with CSS cover/center on desktop and mobile
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original full-window game tabletop environment background, wide landscape approximately 16:9, opaque.
Primary request: Paint a polished, bright, warm, welcoming garden tabletop scene with an exceptionally calm empty cream-colored light wood surface occupying roughly 80 percent of the whole image, suitable as a real playable background under interface cards.
Style reference: The project's viewed cover-v1.webp is a warm sunny hand-painted garden scene with teal details, coral flowers, soft green foliage, pale golden wood and gently dimensional toy-like materials. Use only that art direction and palette, never its depicted cards, tokens, props or composition.
Scene/backdrop: An empty pale wooden garden tabletop seen almost straight from above. The tabletop covers nearly the entire image including the center and all bottom area. Only the outermost narrow edges and corners have restrained soft garden greenery and a few coral/cream flowers, with a hint of sunny garden depth at the very top edge.
Style/medium: High quality original hand-painted illustration, rounded natural forms, subtle cream paper texture, gentle warm shadows, refined family board-game atmosphere.
Composition/framing: Wide approximately 16:9. The central 80 percent must be continuous quiet pale cream / very light honey wood with barely visible broad horizontal wood grain. No focal subject in the center. No high contrast plank borders, hard lines, busy dappled shadows or objects on the tabletop. The empty table surface must fill a centered tall narrow phone crop as well. Decorative garden border small and restrained.
Lighting/mood: Soft diffuse morning sunlight, warm but very pale, low contrast lighting across the table, shadows only at extreme corners. Cheerful serene premium game environment.
Color palette: Pale cream #F6F2E8 table, restrained muted leafy greens and teal #247C75 at far edges, tiny warm gold #F4BE45 and coral #E77A60 accents.
Constraints: This is ONLY a blank environmental background. All real game cards and components will be rendered later by code. Absolutely no cards, card backs, card piles, coins, medallions, dice, tokens, counters, pawns, meeples, trays, boards, tiles, game pieces or any depicted game components. No cups, jars, fabrics or tableware. No people, animals, creatures, characters or faces. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, symbols or UI. Keep the center empty and clean.
